label: Small business income tax offset, aggregated turnover limit
quote: $5 million, you can access the small business income tax offset

legislation.application: Treasury Laws Amendment (Enterprise Tax Plan) Act 2017 (No. 41, 2017) Sch 3 item 20 for the 2016-17 income year and later income years (item 22)

notes: Turnover must be less than this amount. The page prints $5 million, so the record has no pattern. The page states no start date. The $5 million threshold is in ITAA 1997 s 328-357, inserted by the Treasury Laws Amendment (Enterprise Tax Plan) Act 2017 (No. 41, 2017) Sch 3 item 20 for the 2016-17 income year and later income years (item 22): https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2017A00041/asmade
